author: Arcscaler
text: CISA just added SonicWall SSLVPN flaw CVE-2026-19868 to KEV. Actively exploited, and it can bypass SAML-enforced MFA.

author: EvilData
text: MFA bypass on a firewall. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN (CVE-2026-19868): valid credentials for an alternate auth method skip SAML and its MFA. Actively exploited — added to CISA KEV today. Affects 7.3.3-7015 & older, 8.2.2-8015 & older. Patch by Nov 20.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2024-27834 added to CISA KEV.

author: The_Tradesman1
text: WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: lvpcfix
text: CISA has a live, actively exploited RCE in Livewire 3 — the component baked into a huge share of Laravel apps — with a fix (3.6.4) that's months overdue on many stacks.

author: RansomVault
text: Hackers Target OpenSSH "SSHole" Flaw (CVE-2026-123158) Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot. Attackers are already exploiting the OpenSSH flaw that lets them sign in to accounts that have no password set on Linux systems running OpenSSH on musl.

author: cloudsa
text: CISO Daily Briefing: cPGuard's hijacked update channel (5.88.12–5.88.19) ran as root on ~2,950 hosting servers; the patch removes the backdoor, not the stolen credentials. OpenSSH on Alpine/musl (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) lets 257–1,024-byte passwords into no-password accounts.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-46580 (CVSS 8.8) - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to indirect prompt injection via malicious .prompttemplate files. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-44688 - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious file/directory names. CVSS 8.8. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: webtkdev
text: A prompt-injection filter is not a security boundary. Junie GitHub Action before 1.6.4: HTML-encoded text slipped past its filter (CVE, Nov 6).

author: tchsignal
text: Researchers found a way to bypass ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode, a security feature designed to reduce the risk of sensitive information leaving conversations through prompt injection attacks. OpenAI patched it.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical AI Agent RCE in OpenHuman (CVE-2026-54143, CVSS 9.8). External channel messages cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval for host RCE. Upgrade to 0.57.13.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found the attack in about two weeks. Four engineers spent about two months building the fix. That's the PHP2Shell timeline, per IEEE Spectrum. 70,000+ attack attempts observed within two days of the patch.

author: SlavaOPs
text: $6 and 28 Minutes: what it cost Claroty researchers to recreate, with off-the-shelf AI tools, the exploit that turned European supermarket freezers up to 50°C.

author: r3dbrothers
text: New attack technique: victim visits a webpage, page drops CLAUDE.md into Downloads, victim runs claude there, agent obeys the file, attacker gets a shell.

author: stretchcloud
text: $1,279 average cost per working root exploit when OpenAI pointed autonomous GPT-6 Cyber at the Linux kernel: 2,308 potential vulnerabilities flagged, 1,724 reproduced, 948 turned into working local privilege escalation exploits.

author: lan1016ap
text: OpenAI Says Its AI Found 81 Firefox Bugs. Who Gets Access—and Who Doesn't?

author: checkleaked
text: Your Claude Code secrets are in 1,122 GitHub repos — rotate now. Today: AI coding assistant leaks secrets, SonicWall SSL-VPN bypassed, runaway AI breaches WorkOS, fake tools.

author: sudheerdotai
text: Claude Code's "don't ask again" can write your password into .claude/settings.local.json. Apiiro: 1,122 public GitHub copies hold secrets (2,539 across history/forks/logs). Of 16 coding agents checked, only Claude Code does this by default.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta breached real organizations as collateral damage during capability evaluations, hitting Hugging Face, a U.S. Census Bureau site, and dozens more between July and October 2026. Pillar Security counted 21 public disclosures.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Microsoft: AI agents turn GitHub secrets into cloud theft. One observed ARTEX case went from secret searches to Azure Key Vault data theft in 5 minutes. Rotate leaked credentials and audit application sign-ins.

author: scantinelai
text: Nx Supply-Chain Attack Steals npm Token via GitHub Workflow Bug.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Malicious RubyGem strutil-core 1.0.1 runs a credential-stealing worm (Shai-Hulud descendant) the moment it is installed; published 1 Nov 2026 by account jamnajiea.

author: infrastack_ai
text: 21 malicious packages caught in the last 24 hours: 20 on npm, 1 on PyPI (automic-style-engine, hello-bat-fwi9, monopw, monobomber, tw-motion-css). Uninstall and rotate keys.

author: pavhori
text: The $6.3B Binance heist started with one engineer searching for an AI coding tool and installing a tampered Homebrew package, per Binance's Nov 3 report.

author: Vesper7786
text: Chainalysis confirmed hackers compromised sensitive credentials for all of its users: names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens.
